mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CrossTeamIsolation removes the rule that outsider operations are always denied. The injection forces an Operation where the caller's team differs from the task's team yet opOutcome = POAllowed, which is exactly the cross-team leakage the assertion forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamViolation { some op: Operation | op.opCaller.userTeam != op.opTask.taskTeam and op.opOutcome = POAllowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OwnerOnlyShareControl removes the constraint that only RelOwner may successfully invoke KChangeSharedWith. The injection forces a non-owner (RelTeamAdmin) to achieve POAllowed on KChangeSharedWith, violating FR-010 and SC-011.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ShareControlViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = KChangeSharedWith and op.opRel = RelTeamAdmin and op.opOutcome = POAllowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the one-to-one ownership constraint on AuditEntries. The injection places the same AuditEntry into two distinct Operations' opAuditEntries, simulating a re-attributed (mutated) entry — exactly the invariant AppendOnly is meant to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | some ae: AuditEntry | ae in op1.opAuditEntries and ae in op2.opAuditEntries }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditCompleteness removes the requirement that every allowed mutation produce an audit entry. The injection forces an allowed CreateTask operation with an empty opAuditEntries set, which is exactly the missing-audit-entry scenario FR-015 and SC-007 prohibit.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = KCreateTask and op.opOutcome = POAllowed and no op.opAuditEntries }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ShareeCannotDelete removes the rule that a sharee's DELETE attempt is denied. The injection forces a RelSharee-KDeleteTask operation to succeed (POAllowed), violating Q3=B and the byte-equivalent 404 contract for sharee deletes.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ShareeDeleteViolation { some op: Operation | op.opRel = RelSharee and op.opKind = KDeleteTask and op.opOutcome = POAllowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditActorRoleSnapshot removes the constraint that the recorded actor_role in an audit entry matches the actor's actual role. The injection forces an AuditEntry where auditActorRole disagrees with auditActor.userRole, simulating a misattributed role snapshot that FR-016 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.auditActorRole != ae.auditActor.userRole }
